atoms.a: When did World War One end?

feedback.finish: Germany signed an agreement to end the war, and peace was restored to Europe at 11 o’clock on the 11th day of the 11th month.
An armistice is an agreement for peace that is signed to end a war. This is why we refer to the 11th of November as “Armistice Day”.

instruction.text: Do you think British people felt these emotions when the war ended? Drag them to the correct group.

hint.text: Select the images to hear the emotion.

feedback.finish: When the armistice was signed, Britain, France and the other countries that fought against Germany celebrated.

atoms.a: Many soldiers died during the war, but what do you think happened to those who survived?
b: ++They went back home to their families.

feedback.end: The soldiers returned home, and many were given training by the government so they could get new jobs.

instruction.text: After the war, we made sure to remember the soldiers that died. Select the middle gravestone to learn more.

feedback.end: There are many memorials and war cemeteries in France and Belgium. People visit them to pay their respects to the soldiers that fought in the war.
